title: Monster Smoked Meatloaf
description: This monster smoked meatloaf recipe is a beef and sausage meatloaf flavored with chunky salsa, barbecue sauce, and malt vinegar and smoked for hours.
ingredients: 5 pounds ground beef, broken into small chunks
2 pounds sausage, broken into small chunks
1 cup bread crumbs, or more as needed
2 tablespoons barbeque glaze (such as Jack Daniel's®)

steps.text: Stir salsa, eggs, onion, ¼ cup barbecue sauce, ¼ cup mustard, ¼ cup ketchup, Parmesan cheese, Sriracha sauce, soy sauce, malt vinegar, meatloaf seasoning mix, salt, garlic powder, and black pepper together in a large bowl; stir in beef and sausage until thoroughly mixed. Add enough bread crumbs to bring meatloaf mixture together.
Line a container with plastic wrap with several inches overhang; pack meatloaf mixture into the container. Refrigerate until set, 3 to 4 hours.
Preheat a smoker to 250 degrees F (121 degrees C) and add wood chips according to manufacturer's directions.
Line a wire rack with aluminum foil; place in an aluminum foil-lined cake pan. Lift meatloaf onto the prepared rack using the plastic wrap overhang; discard plastic wrap.
Smoke meatloaf until no longer pink in the center, about 3 hours.
Combine barbecue glaze, 2 tablespoons barbecue sauce, 2 tablespoons mustard, 2 tablespoons ketchup, and Worcestershire sauce in a small bowl; baste meatloaf with topping.
Continue smoking until an instant-read thermometer inserted into center reads 185 degrees F (85 degrees C), 1 to 2 hours more.
